args.summary: Completed KG constrained OpenSeesPy modeling of a four span (30+40+40+30 m) cast-in-place continuous box girder with three modeled twin-column piers. Section properties: A=8.45 m², I=4.9374 m⁴; owner unit weight 26.5 kN/m³ gives self-weight 223.925 kN/m. Highway Class I loading used four lanes, xi=0.67, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/340/340/320 kN; modal f1=3.1385 Hz and impact factor mu=0.1864. OpenSeesPy generation and L1/L2/L3 checks succeeded. Results include self-weight support reactions [2451, 8658, 9120, 8686, 2435] kN; maximum positive lane moment 11318.8 kN·m and maximum negative lane moment -8971.8 kN·m. Note bearing shear modulus was absent from the description; the KG executable supplied Ge=1.0 MPa when calculating bearing stiffness.
